_comment: Intentional exceptions for the phantom-ref CI gate (check-phantom-tables.mjs). Every entry is a `.from()` table or `.rpc()` function that does NOT exist in the live Supabase schema but is referenced ON PURPOSE. Keep this list SMALL and REASONED. When a backend is built for one of these, remove its entry (it will then be in the manifest and pass on its own).

nonPublicTargets._comment: Real targets that live outside the public schema the manifest snapshots (Postgres catalogs, auth schema, storage buckets). Not phantoms.
nonPublicTargets.users: alias for auth.users after schema switch in some services

unbuiltFeatureTables._comment: Product features whose UI ships but whose backend table was never built. Each read/write is wrapped in try/catch and degrades to an empty state (verified). Build the table -> the entry auto-clears. Do NOT let this list grow without a matching product decision.
unbuiltFeatureTables.clawback_audit_log: agent clawback audit — unbuilt (AgentAnalyticsDashboard degrades to empty)
unbuiltFeatureTables.club_activity: club activity feed — unbuilt (ClubActivityFeed degrades to empty)
unbuiltFeatureTables.hand_results: legacy hand-results read — superseded by hand_history (HorseOrchestrator)
unbuiltFeatureTables.members: legacy members alias — superseded by club_members

unbuiltFeatureRpcs._comment: RPCs referenced by shipped UI that were never created in the DB. Callers handle the error and degrade. Build the function -> the entry auto-clears.
unbuiltFeatureRpcs.verify_ledger_totals: optional ledger-verify RPC — ChipFlowService has a working client-side paginated fallback
unbuiltFeatureRpcs.promote_next_waitlisted_player: intentionally absent — the engine's notifyWaitlistSeatOpen (server/src, sweep 6) is the AUTHORITATIVE cash-table waitlist promoter on a seat-open event. TableService's client-side best-effort call no-ops when the RPC is missing (error handled); creating the RPC would double-seat/double-notify against the server path.
unbuiltFeatureRpcs.fn_respond_friend_challenge: BUILT 2026-07-29 (friend-challenge accept/decline) — schema manifest update pending the PAT-rotation deploy fix; remove after manifest regen
unbuiltFeatureRpcs.fn_bump_friend_challenge_progress: BUILT 2026-07-29 (friend-challenge progress) — manifest update pending; remove after regen

phantomColumns._comment: BUILT columns whose columns-manifest entry is pending regeneration (deploy blocked by PAT rotation 2026-07-29). Remove once the manifest is regenerated.
phantomColumns._comment_write_backlog_2026_08_27: WRITE-PAYLOAD BACKLOG 2026-08-27. The gate now inspects .update()/.insert()/.upsert() payloads, not just .select(). It found these pre-existing writes naming columns that do not exist — each is a control that 400s at runtime, the same class as the Settings save, Delete Table and Save Note failures fixed the same day. Listed here so the gate BLOCKS NEW ones immediately instead of waiting for the backlog to clear. This list must only ever SHRINK: verify against the live schema, fix the write, delete the entry.
